title: Centaury
summary: CENTAURY, noun The name of a plant, and a genus of plants, of numerous species. The lesser centaury is a species of Gentiana. centaury bears the popular names of knapweed, bluebottle, sultan, and star

inlines.v: CENTAURY, noun The name of a plant, and a genus of plants, of numerous species. The lesser centaury is a species of Gentiana. centaury bears the popular names of knapweed, bluebottle, sultan, and star-thistle.
